== Name
verse-subs - explicit verse substitutions

== Description

.S01 Normal title (C)
[verse,subs="none"]
S01 *Bold* {value} (C) link:https://example.org/inactive[Inactive].
  S02 literal indent.

.S03 Normal title (C)
[verse,subs="none"]
____
S03 *Bold* {value} (C) footnote:[Inactive].
  S04 literal indent.

S05 final line.
____

[verse,subs="-replacements"]
S06 *Bold* {value} (C).
  S07 link:https://example.org/control[Control (R)].

[verse,subs="-replacements"]
____
S08 *Bold* {value} (C).
  S09 pass:r[(TM)] and pass:[(R)].
____

[verse,subs="quotes"]
____
S10 *Bold* {value} (C).
  S11 _italic_ footnote:[Inactive].
____

[verse,subs="replacements"]
____
S12 *Bold* {value} (C).
  S13 (R) footnote:[Inactive].
____

[verse,subs="normal"]
____
S14 *Bold* {value} (C) pass:[(R)].
  S15 hard break +
    S16 after break.
____

After (C), *bold*, and ordinary
    wrapped prose.
